rejection_reason: Parked (not dropped): the source itself is fine - Public Domain licence read directly from both view endpoints, and the two series abut in 2023 with the current one updating (3,434 -> 3,439 rows since 2026-09-18). It is parked on the target contract: only facilities that reported an overflow ever appear in either series, so a facility-day grid built from these tables alone has a survivorship-biased negative class, and no Maryland collection-system registry (MDE / EPA ICIS-NPDES) has been identified or tested. The 2023 row-level reconciliation and the novelty check are also still open. Blocked on whether a facility registry is obtainable.
prediction_question: For a Maryland collection system on a given day, will a sanitary sewer overflow be reported?
prediction_time: Start of the target day, using rainfall observations up to that moment, facility identity and season.
target_definition: Binary: at least one reported overflow for a facility on the target date. Event records collapse to facility-day units. Overflow type, cause and volume are outcomes and excluded.
